description: This file defines an abstract supervisor actor for managing sharded persistent actors within an Akka-based system. It handles actor lifecycle management including exponential backoff restarts, shutdown, and error handling. The class is parameterized by an entity ID type and includes abstract methods for configuration and specific behavior implementation.

classes.name: AbstractPersistenceSupervisor
classes.description: An abstract actor class that supervises sharded persistent actors with exponential backoff restart, shutdown, and error handling capabilities. It is designed to be subclassed with specific entity behavior.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Abstract method to get the ID of the entity this actor supervises.

methods.name: getPersistenceActorProps
methods.description: Provides Props for creating the child persistence actor for a given entity ID.

methods.name: getExponentialBackOffConfig
methods.description: Reads the background exponential backoff configuration.

methods.name: getShutdownBehaviour
methods.description: Determines the shutdown behavior for the supervised actor.

methods.name: getUnavailableExceptionBuilder
methods.description: Creates an exception builder indicating the entity is unavailable.

methods.name: supervisorStrategy
methods.description: Returns the default supervisor strategy, which stops children on failure.

methods.name: preStart
methods.description: Initializes the actor, retrieving the entity ID, child props, shutdown behavior and starting the child.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the message handling behavior during startup, warning about messages.

methods.name: becomeActive
methods.description: Sets the actor to active state, handling messages and termination.

methods.name: becomeCorrupted
methods.description: Sets the actor to a corrupted state, handling errors and timeouts.

methods.name: passivate
methods.description: Triggers passivation of the child by sending a PoisonPill.

methods.name: startChild
methods.description: Starts the supervised persistence child actor if not already active.

methods.name: childTerminated
methods.description: Handles termination of the child actor, scheduling restart with exponential backoff.

methods.name: getCorruptedReceiveTimeout
methods.description: Returns a randomized receive timeout for the corrupted state based on configuration.

methods.name: calculateRestartDelay
methods.description: Calculates delay before restarting child actor with exponential backoff.

methods.name: calculateNextBackOff
methods.description: Computes the next backoff duration, bounded between min and max durations.

methods.name: randomize
methods.description: Returns a randomized duration within a factor of the base duration.

methods.name: boundDuration
methods.description: Bounds a duration within specified min and max durations.

methods.name: forwardToChildIfAvailable
methods.description: Forwards messages to the child actor if available, or replies with an exception.

methods.name: replyUnavailableException
methods.description: Replies to sender with an exception if the child actor is unavailable.

methods.name: warnAboutMessagesDuringStartup
methods.description: Logs warning messages received during startup phase.
